caseName: Oregon-Washington Railroad & Navigation Co. v. Stoddard Lumber Co.
caseNameFull: Oregon-Washington Railroad & Navigation Company v. Stoddard Lumber Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oregon.
attorneys: Mr. Waldemar Van Cott, Mr. Edward M. Allison, Jr., and Mr. William D. Riter for plaintiff in error. Mr. W. Lair Thompson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of §237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
